docs.title: Set up Cliniko bookings
docs.text:
This guide takes one clinic from nothing to live phone bookings. Plan for about an hour, most of it in Cliniko. You need:

  • a super-admin to switch Bookings on for your operator (step 1);
  • someone who can change the clinic's Cliniko settings and add a Cliniko user;
  • an operator admin login on callcat.ai for the clinic's client;
  • a scenario-mode, English agent for that client.

Before you start, agree with the clinic in writing how their patient data is handled: the verification you will use, how long call data is kept, and who gets alert emails. The warnings on the settings are the points to record in their data protection impact assessment.

docs.title: 1. Switch bookings on for the operator
docs.text: A super-admin opens Super Admin → All Operators and turns on the Bookings switch in the operator's row (see Administration). The Bookings tab then appears on every client of that operator.

docs.title: 2. Prepare Cliniko
docs.text:
Phone offers follow the clinic's online-booking setup in Cliniko. Anything that isn't online-bookable can be cancelled by phone but not moved. Check these in Cliniko (the names below are Cliniko's; see Cliniko's help if a menu has moved):

  1. Online bookings are on. If online booking is off for the whole account, no appointment can be moved by phone.
  2. Each business is shown in online bookings.
  3. Each practitioner who should be bookable by phone is shown in online bookings (Settings → Users & practitioners, edit the practitioner) and offers the right appointment types at that business.
  4. Each appointment type that can be moved by phone has Show in online bookings ticked.
  5. Minimum notice for cancellations (Settings → General settings → Cancellations) is set, or you plan to set custom hours on our side (step 5). Inside this window the agent never changes an appointment; it takes a message.
  6. The online-booking lead time and how far in advance patients may book are what you want. The agent only offers times inside these limits, and never more than four weeks ahead.
  7. Patients have what the agent checks. With the default verification the agent asks for the date of birth and matches the caller ID against the patient's phone numbers. Patients with no date of birth or no phone number in Cliniko can't be verified that way (see step 5).

Appointments longer than their type

An appointment that was stretched beyond its appointment type's length can only be cancelled by phone, not moved, so the agent never shortens or overbooks a slot.

docs.title: 3. Create a dedicated Cliniko user and API key
docs.text:
The API key can do everything the Cliniko user who created it can do, so create a user just for callcat.ai instead of using a manager's own login.

  1. In Cliniko, add a new user for callcat.ai, for example callcat.ai phone agent. Give it the narrowest role that can view patients and manage appointments. Start with Receptionist. Avoid Administrator, Bookkeeper and Power receptionist: the panel accepts them but warns that the role is broad.
  2. Sign in to Cliniko as that user. Open My info (under the user's name), set Allow yourself to create and use API keys to Yes and press Update user.
  3. Under API keys, click Manage API keys → Add an API key, name it callcat.ai, and click Create API key.
  4. Copy the key now. Cliniko shows it only once. Keep it somewhere safe until step 4 and don't paste it into email or chat.

Cliniko's own guide: Generate a Cliniko API key.

docs.title: 4. Connect Cliniko
docs.text:
1. In callcat.ai, open Clients, choose the clinic's client, and open the Bookings tab.
  2. In Cliniko connection, paste the key into Cliniko API key and press Connect. The key is checked against Cliniko first ("Checking the key…").
  3. On success you see Connected to Cliniko., the key's last 4 characters, the key owner and their role. The Businesses, Settings and Agents cards appear.

If connecting fails, the message says why:

Message What to do This doesn't look like a Cliniko API key. Copy the key again in full from Cliniko. Cliniko rejected this key. Check it is active and copied in full. The key was archived or mistyped. Create a new one. This Cliniko user's role is too narrow Give the Cliniko user a broader role, or create the key from another user. Cliniko couldn't be reached. Try again in a moment. A temporary problem. Try again. Cliniko is rate limiting this key. Try again in a minute. Other software is using the same Cliniko user heavily. Wait a minute.

Then check the Businesses and what can be changed by phone card:

  • every business that should take phone changes shows Online-bookable;
  • the practitioner and appointment type list is what the clinic expects;
  • each business has a timezone (a business marked Timezone unknown is blocked);
  • Notes from the last check has nothing unexpected.

If something is missing, fix it in Cliniko (step 2) and press Re-verify on the connection card.

docs.title: 5. Choose the settings
docs.text:
Go through the Settings card with the clinic. The defaults suit most clinics; each option is explained in the settings reference.

Setting Default When to change it How callers are verified Date of birth Choose a stricter option if the clinic wants more than caller ID plus date of birth, or Full name if many patients have no date of birth in Cliniko. Callers with no caller ID Surname and date of birth Choose Don't book: take a message if the clinic doesn't want web-widget or withheld-number callers to change appointments. Details match, but the number isn't on file Take a message Choose the full-name option if many patients call from numbers Cliniko doesn't have. Callers then learn their details matched. After a change Carry on with the intake questions Choose Close with a booking line if a booking call should end once the change is made. Email to the patient No email Choose Send an email only if Cliniko doesn't already email patients about changes. Cancellation notice Use Cliniko's rule Choose Custom hours if Cliniko's notice is unset or 0 (required then), or if phone changes need a different window. Keep call data for 90 days Match the clinic's agreement. No-caller-ID daily cap 10 Lower it to be stricter; 0 stops bookings on calls without a caller ID.

Press Save.

docs.title: 6. Switch bookings on for the agent
docs.text:
1. In the Agents card, find the agent. It must be enabled, in scenario mode and English.
  2. Under Businesses, tick the business or businesses this agent answers for. They must all be online-bookable and share one timezone.
  3. Turn the agent's switch on. If it's refused, the reason shows under the agent (see Bookings troubleshooting).

Nothing else changes in the agent's set-up. Bookings sit alongside its intake questions and triggers: a caller who asks about an existing appointment is taken into the booking steps, then the call carries on.

docs.title: 7. Test before going live
docs.text:
Test with a test patient, never a real one.

  1. In Cliniko, create a test patient with a date of birth and your own mobile number, and book them two appointments a few days out: one with an online-bookable practitioner and type, and one you can cancel. Keep them outside the cancellation notice window.
  2. Phone test. Call the agent's number from that mobile. Ask to move the first appointment, give the date of birth, pick an offered time and say yes. Check in Cliniko that it moved. Call again and cancel the second one.
  3. Wrong details. Call again and give a wrong date of birth twice. The agent should say it can't confirm and take a message, without saying what was wrong.
  4. No caller ID. Place a browser test call. It has no caller ID, so the agent asks for the details in Callers with no caller ID (surname and date of birth by default).
  5. Open the Audit log on the Bookings tab and the calls in Calls. Check each step is there, the transcript shows [date of birth] instead of the date, and the summary email has an Appointment section.

What happens on a booking call describes each step, so you can tell expected behaviour from a problem.

docs.title: 8. Go live
docs.text:
Before you point real callers at the agent, check:

  • [ ] The clinic has agreed the verification, data retention and alert recipients in writing.
  • [ ] Alert emails reach someone who reads them. They go to the addresses in Call Summary Recipients on the client's Info tab, or to its Contact Email if that list is empty.
  • [ ] The test patient and its appointments are archived in Cliniko.
  • [ ] Someone checks the Audit log and the first week's booking calls (see Running bookings day to day).
  • [ ] Bookings is switched on only for the agents that should have it.

docs.title: Bookings troubleshooting
docs.text: If something here doesn't solve it, note the call (its View call link in the audit log) and contact support.

docs.title: Connecting
docs.text:
I can't see the Bookings tab

The tab is for operator admins and super-admins, and an operator admin only sees it after a super-admin has switched Bookings on for the operator (Administration). Regular users never see it.

\"This doesn't look like a Cliniko API key\" or \"Cliniko rejected this key\"

Copy the key again in full; Cliniko shows it only once, so if you no longer have it, create a new one. Check the key hasn't been archived in Cliniko, and that the user who created it still has Allow yourself to create and use API keys set to Yes.

\"This Cliniko user's role is too narrow\"

Cliniko refused a request the connection needs, such as reading patients, practitioners or appointments. Give the Cliniko user a role that can view patients and manage appointments, then press Re-verify (or Replace key with a key from a user who has that role).

The card warns the key belongs to a user with a broad role

The key owner is an Administrator, Bookkeeper or Power receptionist. It works, but a leaked key could do everything that user can. Create a dedicated user with a narrower role and use Replace key (Set up Cliniko bookings).

A business shows \"Not online-bookable\" or is missing practitioners

Phone offers follow Cliniko's online-booking setup. Make sure online bookings are on, and that the business, the practitioner and the appointment type are each shown in online bookings, with the practitioner offering that type at that business. Then press Re-verify. See Prepare Cliniko.

\"Timezone unknown: bookings are blocked for this business\"

Cliniko didn't give a timezone for the business or the key owner. Set the timezone in Cliniko, then press Re-verify.

docs.title: Switching agents on
docs.text:
The agent's switch is greyed out

The agent must be enabled, in scenario mode and English; the note under the agent says which. The switch is also greyed out while the connection isn't Connected (for example Key rejected) or the operator's Bookings switch is off.

\"Cliniko's cancellation notice is unset or 0\"

Cliniko has no minimum notice for cancellations. Either set one in Cliniko and press Re-verify, or choose Custom hours under Cancellation notice and save.

\"The chosen businesses must share one timezone\"

One agent can only act for businesses in the same timezone. Use a separate agent for the other businesses.

An agent's bookings switch turned itself off

Either Cliniko rejected the key (the connection shows Key rejected; see Change the key), or the overnight check found the agent's businesses are no longer online-bookable. Fix the business in Cliniko, press Re-verify, and switch the agent back on.

docs.title: On calls
docs.text:
The agent didn't offer to change the appointment

Check the agent's bookings switch is on and Cliniko is Connected. The booking steps start when the caller asks about an appointment they already have; a new booking, a different practitioner or a different appointment type becomes a message.

A real patient couldn't be verified

Open the call's rows in the audit log. Common causes:

  • the date of birth in Cliniko is missing or different;
  • the patient called from a number not on their Cliniko record (with the default unknown-number setting the agent takes a message);
  • the name in Cliniko is spelled differently (names must match exactly, apart from capitals, accents and punctuation);
  • another patient has the same details and number, so the agent can't tell them apart;
  • a daily limit was reached (see the limits).
The agent says it can't move an appointment, only cancel it

The appointment's practitioner or appointment type isn't online-bookable, or the appointment is longer than its appointment type. The agent takes a message for the clinic to move it.

The agent won't change an appointment that is soon

It is inside the cancellation notice window, which covers moves as well as cancellations. The agent takes a message.

The agent finds no free times, but the diary has gaps

The agent only offers times that online booking would offer: the same practitioner and appointment type, inside Cliniko's lead time and booking window, and at most four weeks ahead. Gaps shorter than the appointment type, or outside the practitioner's online availability, aren't offered.

The caller was told the clinic will confirm the change

Cliniko didn't confirm the change in time. The clinic got an alert email ("A booking change could not be confirmed"). Check the appointment in Cliniko and call the patient.

The transcript shows [date of birth]

That's by design: dates of birth are removed from transcripts. The recording still has it until data deletion.

Some of an agent's older calls lost their transcripts and recordings

Once an agent has bookings on, all its calls older than Keep call data for are cleared each day, including calls from before bookings were switched on. See Data deletion.
